run_generate_test_artifacts: run the script with a sklearn version argument to train models and push them to Hugging Face Hub
push_repo_to_hf_hub: push a local sklearn model repository folder to the skops-tests org on Hugging Face Hub
create_repos_with_and_without_config: create Hugging Face Hub repos for a trained estimator with and without a config file
get_tabular_classifiers: yield sklearn tabular classifier pipelines like logistic regression and histogram gradient boosting
save_sample_and_predict: save model input samples as JSON and write model predictions to output JSON files
